title: What is hallucination?

body.text: produces information that sounds credible but is false
— citing people, statistics, or events that don't actually exist. It's an important limitation to watch for, especially when using answers for serious work.

example: "For the statistic you just gave, please also provide the source and year of publication so I can verify it."

title: Other limitations to know

body.text: cut off at the model's training date (knowledge cutoff)
, so don't rely on it for the latest news. Always verify important facts against other sources.

example: "I know your data has a cutoff — can you tell me what changes in 2024 I should be aware of?"
